method: Primary GitHub PR metadata and patches; pinned Git object source snapshots. Exact-added-line screening is only triage; findings below use concrete runtime source paths. No live/provider/browser tests or deployment in this review.

rows.title: Add OSS Scanner build and threat model
rows.comparison: Scanner Dockerfile/threat model only; no runtime fix. Optional Origin-specific threat model is useful, but upstream approval-free/cloud trust decisions conflict with Origin human merge consent/workspace ACLs. No scanner enrollment/contact was performed.

rows.title: Bots' browsers keep their own Chrome profile, so sign-ins survive closes
rows.comparison: Both legacy agentBrowserIntegration environments omit AGENT_BROWSER_PROFILE and keep only saved-state restore. Persistent localStorage/IndexedDB sign-ins can disappear after close/restart. Port isolated kept-profile lifecycle/deletion/backup exclusions; do not copy profile secrets between members.

rows.title: Live browser panel: inputs travel in batches and frames stop waiting a round trip each
rows.comparison: Both legacy browser-live.ts retain ACK-paced maxFps15 streaming (567); upstream batches input and removes a frame RTT. Origin lacks upstream browser-stream-v1.ts, so adapt its current browser-input-queue/BrowserPanel rather than blind cherry-pick.

rows.title: Live browser panel: show a page's own question, and restart a page that stopped answering for the person
rows.comparison: browser-dialogs and host/browser modules plus stream-v1 are absent in both. Useful human page alert/confirm/prompt and stuck-page restart support; adapt as a browser subsystem slice while keeping person-control leases and egress.

rows.title: Sign-in: a bot types a code from the person's own inbox into the site it was sent for
rows.comparison: Both login-fill.ts retain person-entered OTP handoff and omit CODE_FROM_INBOX. Inbox-derived codes are useful only with explicit owner-mailbox/domain binding and redaction; do not broaden teammate secret access by importing prompt text alone.

rows.title: Webhook automations: the bot that owns one gets its address to set up the sending app
rows.comparison: webhook-address and request/address helpers are absent in both. Owner agents knowing their webhook callback URL is useful, but expose it only through Origin project scope with secret-safe tool output and member revocation.

rows.title: Show Windows caption buttons when the desktop app uses a remote server
rows.comparison: Both electron/preload.cjs43 REMOTE_SAFE omit windowControls although bridge182 defines them. A Windows desktop showing a remote server loses its custom caption controls. Port only this capability plus remote-page IPC tests.

rows.title: fix(server): a slow MCP shutdown no longer fails a turn with nothing in flight
rows.comparison: Both chat-mcp-tools.ts100–108 throw on unconfirmed shutdown even with zero pending calls, and openai-chat.ts864–867 marks cleanup failure as failed turn. Slow Windows process cleanup can overwrite an otherwise completed turn; retain uncertainty errors for genuinely in-flight calls.

rows.title: fix(local-vm): an OpenAI-compatible bot whose Local VM lists no tools gets a clear error, not a silent turn (MOCA-382)
rows.comparison: Both chat-mcp-tools.ts285 accept an unrestricted Local VM tools/list with zero tools. The upstream guard turns a silent no-tool turn into an explicit failure; adapt with isolated empty-catalog fixture.

rows.title: fix(cloud): say what Send to My Cloud could not send and why, and bring chats with Send everything
rows.comparison: Upstream Send to My Cloud transfer UX/modules are mostly absent. Origin uses Convex workspace/chat sync and explicit online model hosts, not upstream paid-cloud migration. Do not reintroduce its sales/UI flow.

rows.title: Webhooks: post straight into a room (from #3139)
rows.comparison: Reconciled room webhook delivery is absent as a complete feature. Could post external build/lead/voice events without spending a model turn; require Origin member/project access, idempotency and no forged participant attribution.

rows.title: Webhooks: a "post" delivery can go straight into a room, with a voice note, without a run
rows.comparison: Original room webhook post/voice-note delivery. Prefer reconciled #3160; not a separate independent feature.

rows.title: chore(release): bump version to 0.1.119
rows.comparison: Upstream package bump to0.1.119; Origin owns independent versions/changelogs.

rows.title: Bring in 10 PRs: account removal, Codex reset time, bounded nudges, model badge, Pop skin, panel focus, busy-thread note, Claude stable prompt, room saves, Today page
rows.comparison: Aggregate of10 changes, not a45th independent feature. Track its constituents separately; additionally codexLimitResetsAt/reset parser is absent from both Origin codex-errors.ts (only display text remains), so the upstream minute/DST fix cannot be copied in isolation.

rows.title: perf(claude): launch with the stable half of the system prompt; volatile half in the first message
rows.comparison: Both retain full turn.system on new Claude launches (claude.ts1110–1113), although live-session volatile updates already exist. Port stable-only launch later; preserve Origin origin-status/Chief/delegation/permission context and verify cache benefit.

rows.title: feat(skins): add pop skin inspired by ClaudeBar
rows.comparison: Pop skin is not present as the new upstream skin. Optional theme proliferation is outside the narrow release and the requested consistent core Origin appearance.

rows.title: feat(sidebar): show each bot's model as a small badge on its avatar
rows.comparison: BotModelBadge.tsx is absent in both. A useful optional actual-model/provider indicator, but static default badges must not mislabel Origin fallback/shared-host execution.

rows.title: fix(rooms): save room threads and room settings before showing them
rows.comparison: Both Store.createGroup mutate this.groups before saveGroups (1041–1042), and createGroupTask changes active/task state before save (1181–1187). Disk write failure leaves unpersisted in-memory room/thread state; upstream adds rollback/save-before-publish. Keep as separate data-loss repair with ENOSPC fixtures.

rows.title: feat(today): a Today page — what your bots finished, what needs you, time saved
rows.comparison: TodayPage/server/today/shared today modules are absent in both. Consider a workspace daily brief built from authorized project outcomes and approvals; do not duplicate Origin Inbox or import unverified time-saved estimates.

rows.title: fix: bound repeated action recovery in OpenAI-compatible turns
rows.comparison: Both openai-chat.ts retain one nudged boolean (638/742) and no protectedMutations fence. After one successful mutation, an automatic announcement nudge can offer the same mutation again. Port bounded progress/duplicate-mutation fencing independently; preserve Origin quota evidence, approvals and unknown-outcome rules.

rows.title: Switch it too: say when a busy thread kept its own model
rows.comparison: Both ThreadModelsLine.tsx16 dispatch followBotModel without onSettled/busy feedback. Busy threads intentionally retain their own model but the switch UI does not explain this. Small useful status repair after the narrow release.

rows.title: feat(computer-panel): hand keyboard focus to the panel and back
rows.comparison: computer-panel-focus helper is absent in both. Add predictable keyboard entry/return and Escape hand-back as a separate UI change, preserving Origin usage popup/model selector focus.

rows.title: feat(accounts): remove added provider accounts
rows.comparison: Both instance removal routes/UI predate added Antigravity removal. Useful if multiple Gemini/Antigravity accounts are offered; retain in-use checks across defaults, fallbacks and shared-host references.

rows.title: Bring in #3031: your profile photo, and the mouse wheel scrolls the computer panel's tabs
rows.comparison: Reconciled profile-photo/tab-wheel import; #3170 is its small wheel slice. Local ProfileSettings/photo-config implementation is absent; integrate with Origin account profile rather than a second local identity.

rows.title: Add profile photos and scrollable computer tabs
rows.comparison: Original profile-photo/tab-wheel PR; use reconciled #3171/#3170 rather than importing this branch too. Upstream user-avatar config changes are absent in both snapshots.

rows.title: Computer panel: the mouse wheel scrolls the tab row sideways (from #3031)
rows.comparison: Both computer-panel-tabs.ts have keyboard navigation but no scrollTabsWithWheel. Plain vertical wheel cannot move an overflowing horizontal tab row; small independent accessibility/responsiveness improvement.

rows.title: Engines: list Antigravity as "Google Gemini (Antigravity)"
rows.comparison: Both Antigravity support labels still read Antigravity. Upstream renames it Google Gemini(Antigravity), useful provider discoverability copy; verify current vendor naming before release adoption.

rows.title: Mascots: one shared clock, draw only when something changes, pause off-screen
rows.comparison: Shared mascot-clock/motion modules are absent; both CursorAvatar.tsx1127+ still schedule a per-avatar animation effect. Useful shared-clock/offscreen pause work; benchmark Origin long-sidebar CPU and preserve reduced motion.

rows.title: test: fix two e2e tests main fails since #3164 (launch note in steer, cloud-personal tools race)
rows.comparison: Fixes upstream launch-note and cloud-personal tests after #3164. Origin has not adopted those changed runtime seams; take fixtures only alongside the matching feature.

rows.title: fix(mcp): let GitHub MCP's tools through the schema check
rows.comparison: Both strict AJV compiler files omit addKeyword x-mcp-header at22–25. Valid GitHub MCP schemas with string header annotations are rejected as unsupported schemas, removing tools. Port typed annotation support without disabling strict unknown-keyword/type/required validation.

rows.title: Let a team server raise the 512 MB attachments limit
rows.comparison: Both attachments.ts retain fixed512MiB total ceiling. A positive validated environment override is useful for self-hosted team servers; keep per-upload limits, explicit507/no eviction and storage budgeting.

rows.title: fix(cloud): lend this computer from My Cloud's own page, and drop the buttons that now happen by themselves
rows.comparison: My Cloud lending IPC/UI belongs to upstream cloud account pages absent from Origin. Its concepts may inform online Origin model hosts, without importing paid-cloud account logic.

rows.title: Browser S4 and comms e2e: hold on GitHub's macOS and Windows runners
rows.comparison: Upstream new-browser S4/stream-v2 real-Chrome test infrastructure is absent. Use its sealed cross-platform test principle when adopting that engine, not its CI/browser harness wholesale.

rows.title: Browser: open the identity check's page again when Chrome cancels it
rows.comparison: CDP identity-calibration backends are absent in both; this Chrome-cancel recovery applies to the newer upstream browser engine, not Origin legacy agent-browser path yet.

rows.title: Let My Cloud use this computer works on Linux without XDG folders, and says why when it can't
rows.comparison: Linux XDG fallback is in upstream My Cloud lending IPC absent from both. Keep for future machine-sharing work; no current Origin cloud-flow adoption.

rows.title: VPS computers: each bot can use its own SSH alias (from #3087)
rows.comparison: Reconciled per-bot VPS SSH aliases/vps-hosts module are absent. Useful future per-project remote compute, but require explicit machine ownership/project-folder ACLs and offline routing; avoid a broad provider migration during release.

rows.title: VPS computers: each bot can use its own SSH alias
rows.comparison: Original per-bot VPS-alias feature; review the reconciled #3165 implementation once. Do not import both branches.

rows.title: Moving to My Cloud carries this computer's MCP servers, sign-ins, keys, connected apps and HighLevel, once
rows.comparison: Transfers keys, OAuth/MCP/HighLevel and shared broker identities into upstream My Cloud. This conflicts with Origin explicit owner-host consent and keeping subscriptions/credentials on their owners machines; do not import.

rows.title: feat(cloud): send everything to My Cloud by itself, chats included, a row at a time
rows.comparison: Automatic My Cloud migration of local bots/chats is not Origin account/workspace synchronization. Do not copy credential/chat migration into sender-runs/shared-host design.

rows.title: Use this key for every Claude bot no longer breaks Claude (API key) bots
rows.comparison: Subsequently ported narrowly into integration dc652c11a0ce37331aff8a35810a9c86c6162e35; dedicated API routing stays enabled for everyClaudeBot default/true/false, and selected API-key environments report metered billing. Four red failures proved before repair; fake-CLI/server/budget/typecheck evidence is bound in3177-adoption.json. Root owns the separate logical commit; no other upstream feature adopted.

rows.title: Local VM: Cua Driver 0.37.0 and text-only error results
rows.comparison: Cua Driver0.37.0 plus text-only error results/old-desktop gating spans a larger computer runtime. Its mcp-error-result/desktop-updates helpers are absent; validate against Origin current runner and host approval/fallback rules before adopting.

rows.title: chore(release): bump version to 0.1.120
rows.comparison: Upstream package bump to0.1.120; keep independent Origin version/changelog.

rows.title: Control plane: place new Secure HTTPS addresses where there is room
rows.comparison: Upstream Cloudflare account/tunnel/DNS-capacity allocator is not Origin Hetzner/Convex/domain delivery. No deployment or config change adopted.

rows.title: Fix the updater test on main: its copy of the Cloud sign-in was missing cloudLogins
rows.comparison: Adds cloudLogins stub for upstream updater test after #3186. Origin cloudLogins/main changes are absent; no corresponding fixture repair required.

rows.title: Old-desktop e2e: the fake VPS answers on Linux too, and covers a bot's own VPS alias
rows.comparison: Test-only sealed fake PATH and own-VPS alias cases accompany #3165/#3181. Keep as prerequisites if those features are adopted; do not claim their upstream runtime changes from this test-only PR.

redBefore.scenario: Dedicated API instance default/all routes rejected missing key; workspace-key subscription probe was misclassified

claudeDriver.qualification: The file passed in the first full run; a stale config reload expectation failed separately, then was corrected without any further runtime edit.

isolatedHttpFixture.earlierAttempts: Two cleaned-up harness attempts used an unsupported config.instances patch; final fixture uses the actual instance CLI settings route.

adoptedAfterReview.preserved: Native API-key auth classification, instance-owned routing/secret isolation, ranked fallback, owner-host consent and daily API policy remain unchanged outside the narrow routing/billing integration.
limits: Synthetic fake CLI only; no real Claude login, real API key, provider invoice, packaged app or production acceptance
